records.purpose: Read one named stat (sc_actor_stat) of the actor whose entity id is id: your player or a streamed-in NPC. *out_value is the game's own float in the game's own units; 0 on failure. An actor without a record of that stat answers NOT_FOUND, never a silent 0.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*read)(uint64_t id, uint32_t stat, float* out_value);`
Read one named stat (sc_actor_stat) of the actor whose entity id is id: your player or a streamed-in NPC. *out_value is the game's own float in the game's own units; 0 on failure. An actor without a record of that stat answers NOT_FOUND, never a silent 0.
records.ownership: Copied scalar inputs; one float copied to the caller. No allocation, no engine pointer transfer, nothing retained.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD elsewhere before any game access.
records.reentrancy: Read-only game call under a fault guard; no plugin re-entry.
records.results: OK value copied; BAD_ARG id 0, out_value NULL or stat not a 1.0 stat; NOT_FOUND id not streamed in, not an actor, or no record of that stat; UNAVAILABLE game.actor_stats.read not ready; FAILED game fault or non-finite value; WRONG_THREAD off the game thread.
records.absent_capability: Table absent: query_service NOT_FOUND. game.actor_stats.read not ready (a row failed, e.g. actor.stat_names on a build that reordered the stat enum): read answers UNAVAILABLE.
records.cleanup: Read-only: nothing to restore. game.actors' stop withdraws the table and clears the capability.
limitations: Indices and names are static evidence on 4.10.197.2878 (F-4.10.197.2878-006); not run in game.
Units, range and direction of each stat are not pinned; values are raw game floats.
No maximum or threshold per stat in 1.0.
